transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough that just won't go away. It's only been a few days, really.
When did you first notice it?
Actually, thinking about it more, it started about three weeks ago, after I had a cold.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Cold air sets it off, and talking for a long time too. Steam inhalation helps a little.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a chesty cough — I'm bringing up white-to-yellow phlegm, more than my usual morning phlegm.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's mostly in my chest, that's where I feel it. No, it doesn't spread anywhere.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'd rate it about a 6 out of 10. It's disturbing my sleep most nights.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes. It's worst in the morning and at night — the coughing fits last a few minutes each time.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
I've been a bit more breathless than usual when I walk to the shop. I've not coughed up any blood, and no weight loss, night sweats or chest pain.

Thank you for telling me. What you just described can be a sign of something that needs urgent attention. I am pausing these questions. Please seek medical help now: call your local emergency number or tell a member of staff right away.
